notes_for_editor: 1) The 'abandoned' label is only in the OpenStreetMap name tag; the OSM way page says it was last edited over eight years ago, so the label may be stale. Mapcarta copies OSM. 2) Peakery's peak has the same name and a 2,085 m elevation; the match is by name, not by coordinates, so it may not be the same structure. 3) Alberta's FIReS-derived lookout dataset has no Rock Lake record, active or inactive (name search and an inactive-status query both returned none), so the government record is silent on this site. 4) The brief's 'standing' status is not confirmed by any source read. 5) AllTrails returned 403 and is not cited; its search snippet describes a route near Hinton, which is not verified. 6) No build date, staffing history or access rule was found. The story's Alberta tower-type paragraph is general context, not a claim about this site. 7) Story length is near the thin-evidence floor.
